title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code Mods + releases 2.1.287/2.1.288: custom TypeScript functions that rewrite prompts, customize UI, and replace features, shipped inside plugins
bullets.summary: Anthropic introduced Mods on Oct 1, letting teams distribute custom Claude Code behavior through plugins with admin controls; 2.1.288 (Oct 2) adds resume/recovery, plugin and MCP management, and permission fixes.
bullets.how: The Construct: package agent guardrails and house-style prompt rewrites as a plugin mod so every Construct session inherits them; the resume/recovery fixes help long scheduled runs. PRAGMA: a distributable mod is a productizable deliverable for client engineering teams.

bullets.title: Anthropic schedules retirement of Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) for November 30, 2026
bullets.summary: The Developer Platform posted a deprecation notice on Sep 30 with retirement set for Nov 30, 2026.
bullets.how: The Construct: grep routines, skills and repos for the pinned Sonnet 4.5 ID and move them to Sonnet 5.5 before the cutoff. PRAGMA: add a model-deprecation check to client operator handoffs.

bullets.title: OpenAI, Meta and Google are shifting toward persistent agents that manage multiple jobs and retain context
bullets.summary: Business Standard reports the big labs are moving from one-shot assistants to always-on agents with long-lived memory (Oct 2).
bullets.how: The Construct: validates the scheduled-routine plus memory pattern; watch for platform-native persistence that could replace hand-rolled inbox/state files. PRAGMA: a selling point for operator engagements that run continuously.

bullets.title: DigitalOcean opens public preview of managed agent infrastructure with isolated runtimes and governed tool access
bullets.summary: The service bundles isolated agent runtimes, governed tool access and serverless inference (Oct 2).
bullets.how: PRAGMA: a low-ops hosting option for small client agent deployments; The Construct: compare against current runtime cost once pricing is clear.

praxis_lesson: Deprecations and always-on agents arrive together: pinned model IDs and hand-rolled state become liabilities. Keep model names in one config and agent state in portable files so a retirement date is a one-line change.
